name: apogee
description: Apogee inside Claude: drives the apogee binary on this machine. Finds the binary and says so once when Apogee is not installed.

binary.title: Apogee binary
binary.description: The apogee binary to drive, as a path (a leading ~/ is your home). Empty: look in ~/.local/bin for the channel's binary.

channel.title: Apogee channel
channel.description: release looks for apogee, then apogee-dev and apogee-test in ~/.local/bin; dev looks for apogee-dev only, so a development load never drives your production install.
